snippet.title: ROCK BAND | Teaser #2
snippet.description:
This isn’t just a game about music.

It’s about surviving long enough to even reach the stage.

Rock Band Simulator is a chaotic first-person rock band life sim where every day is unstable by design. 🔥

We’re building it with the community.

€1,900 / €5,000 raised
10 days left

If you want it to exist — now is the moment.
